subject: Timothée Chalamet

features.label: LIGHT GREEN EYES
features.vo: Start with the eyes. Light green, with a slight upward tilt.

features.label: HIGH CHEEKBONES
features.vo: High cheekbones give a soft face real structure.

features.label: LONG, STRAIGHT NOSE
features.vo: A long, straight nose keeps the middle of his face sharp.

features.label: SOFT, NARROW JAW
features.chip: no hard angle, and it still works
features.vo: His jaw is narrow and soft. You don't need a sharp jaw.

features.label: MESSY VOLUME
features.vo: And the hair. Messy volume on top frames the whole face.

card.vo: Put it all together and his face card comes out at 87.

cta.vo: Comment who I should break down next.
